c01-hawk.note: A tent whose birds never arrive: the man waits, a hawk keeps to the fold. People and the hawk are added in the image pass.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic overcast daytime, dead calm, no wind photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms and props where they are, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground becomes real limestone, scree, scrub and dry grass. Shields are plain round bronze, no emblem. One small bleached-linen tent on a headland clearing above a calm sea, its shield leaning on it, a wicker basket of a few ravens beside it; no perch. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its mercenary's dress exactly and its tent and basket. He sits alone at the tent's mouth, hands on knees, looking up at the empty sky where a single hawk circles high over the wooded fold below. No other people, no fire. Exactly ONE shield. The photo fills the whole frame edge to edge, no border. Deep focus. Nothing modern.
